title: Nina and the Baby Sparrows
description: NCERT Class 3 English (Marigold): 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows'. New words, comprehension, was / were, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows': window, kind, worried, safe.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows' mean (window, kind, worried, safe); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Nina was ___ about the baby birds, so she helped them.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A word that means out of danger is ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The baby birds were safe in the nest.
Nina was kind to every animal.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Nina helped the baby sparrows that lived near her ___.
Nina felt ___, so she helped the baby sparrows.

exemplars: The baby birds were safe in the nest.
Nina was kind to every animal.

nodes.title: Was / Were
nodes.teach_focus: Use 'was' for one (he/she/it was) and 'were' for many (they/you/we were).
nodes.success_criteria: Uses was / were correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of was / were.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the correct word: 'The birds ___ very small.'

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The baby birds were safe in the nest.
Nina was very kind to them.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Nina and the Baby Sparrows': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I was ___ when I helped someone.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The baby birds were safe in the nest.
Nina was kind to every animal.

chapter_test.title: Nina and the Baby Sparrows: Chapter Test

items.prompt: A word that means out of danger is ___.
Nina was ___ about the baby birds, so she helped them.
Nina helped the baby sparrows that lived near her ___.
Nina felt ___, so she helped the baby sparrows.
Choose the correct word: 'The birds ___ very small.'
